name: Sea TV Network Limited
summary: Sea TV Network Ltd. operates within the media and entertainment industry, delivering satellite-based news and entertainment programming to a vast audience of millions of households. The company's extensive range of offerings boasts advanced features such as high-definition (HD) channels, personal video recording (PVR) functionality, and the utilization of MPEG-4 technology. Furthermore, its platform includes parental lock controls, options for pay-per-channel subscriptions, a comprehensive multi-language system, and on-demand video (VOD) services, complemented by dedicated customer support and numerous other benefits. Sea TV Network Ltd. was established on May 21, 2004, and its main operational base is situated in Agra, India.
